snippet.title: The "Forgotten Cousin" of Metal Slug is BACK! Biomechanical Toy Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The legendary 1995 Gaelco arcade classic is finally escaping the 90s! Biomechanical Toy launches on July 16, 2026, for PC and all major consoles. 

Before Metal Slug changed the run-and-gun genre forever in 1996, Zeus Software and Gaelco delivered a beautiful, frantic, and punishingly detailed masterpiece in European arcades: Biomechanical Toy.

Take control of Inguz, a tough-as-nails action hero with serious 90s ponytail energy, and fight your way through a magical kingdom of toys gone rogue. Free caged toy allies to gain temporary combat support, collect power-ups, manage your weapon reloads, and take down massive thematic war-machine bosses across 6 surreal worlds.

Play Biomechanical Toy on Steam, Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch! Add it to your wishlist now at the QUByte Store:
https://www.qubytegames.store/allgames/biomechanical-toy


Brought to you by QUByte Interactive in partnership with Bleem!, this definitive version perfectly preserves the original arcade adrenaline while adding crucial modern features!
